description: This file implements TLS-enabled network listener creation and management for the etcd project, including TLS configuration, certificate generation, and listener wrapping with TLS and socket options.

classes.name: TLSInfo
classes.description: Struct holding TLS configuration details such as certificate files, client authentication options, and verification parameters.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the TLSInfo struct.

methods.name: Empty
methods.description: Checks if both CertFile and KeyFile are empty.

methods.name: SelfCert
methods.description: Generates or loads a self-signed TLS certificate, returning TLSInfo with certificate paths.

methods.name: baseConfig
methods.description: Creates a tls.Config object for initial TLS handshake, including certificate loading and verification setup.

methods.name: cafiles
methods.description: Returns a list of CA file paths for trust verification.

methods.name: ServerConfig
methods.description: Generates tls.Config for server use, including client certificate verification.

methods.name: ClientConfig
methods.description: Generates tls.Config for client use, including server certificate validation.
